_meta.name: English
app.help.title: Keyboard shortcuts (F1 or ?)
app.lang.title: Language
app.mode.batch.title: Batch processing (Ctrl+1)
app.mode.editor.title: Editor (Ctrl+2)
app.mode.review.title: Go through many images quickly: look, fix, move on, delete (Ctrl+3)
batch.cmd.despeckle.desc: Finds small detached pieces (leftover specks) and makes them transparent. Pieces with fewer pixels than the threshold are removed.
batch.cmd.despeckle.label: Despeckle
batch.cmd.downscale.desc: Restores pixel art that was saved enlarged to its original size.
batch.cmd.downscale.label: Downscale 1:1
batch.cmd.extract.desc: Extracts the colors used in the image as a palette PNG. If you give it a name, it is also saved to the palette list.
batch.cmd.extract.label: Extract palette
batch.cmd.index.desc: Converts to a palette (indexed) PNG and makes color 0 transparent (#ffffff00).
batch.cmd.index.label: Indexed PNG
batch.cmd.pack.desc: Combines all images in the list into one sprite sheet (the opposite of Slice frames).
batch.cmd.pack.label: Pack sheet
batch.cmd.recolor.desc: Replaces every color with the closest color of the chosen palette.
batch.cmd.recolor.label: Apply palette
batch.cmd.reduce.desc: Merges similar colors to reduce the color count. The most used colors stay as the representatives.
batch.cmd.reduce.label: Reduce colors
batch.cmd.slice.desc: Cuts a sprite sheet into frames of equal size and saves each one.
batch.cmd.slice.label: Slice frames
batch.cmd.trim.desc: Crops off the transparent outer margin. You can keep a fixed margin if you like.
batch.cmd.trim.label: Trim margins
batch.cmd.upscale.desc: Enlarges pixels as they are by an integer factor (nearest neighbor).
batch.cmd.upscale.label: Upscale
batch.despeckle.diag_title: When off, only pixels touching up, down, left or right form one piece
batch.despeckle.min: Remove pieces with fewer pixels than this
batch.despeckle.note: A group of connected non-transparent pixels counts as one piece (any pixel with some alpha counts as content). Pieces smaller than the threshold are erased to full transparency; images with nothing to erase are skipped. Example: 4 → removes specks of 1–3 pixels.
batch.downscale.note: Auto detects the upscale factor from the length of same-color runs.
batch.extract.force: Overwrite if the name already exists
batch.extract.note: Extracts the colors used in the image as a palette PNG (1 color = 1px, a single row). Most used colors first, transparent color excluded, alpha set to 255. With more than 256 colors, run Reduce colors first.
batch.extract.save_hint: Once saved, you can pick it right away in 'Apply palette'. Only available with a single file.
batch.files.already: That file is already in the list
batch.files.empty_hint: or use the + Files / + Folder buttons above
batch.files.empty_title: Drag PNG files or folders here
batch.files.recursive_title: Include subfolders when adding a folder
batch.index.note: Colors are ordered by first appearance in the image. Images with more than 255 colors need Reduce colors or Apply palette first.
batch.only_shown.one: Run on the 1 visible file only
batch.only_shown.other: Run on the {n} visible files only
batch.only_shown_title: When off, every file in the list is processed regardless of the filter
batch.output.backup_title: Copies the original of each overwritten file into a .sprite-tools-backup folder in the same folder
batch.output.example_dir_empty: hero.png → (folder)/hero.png · the suffix may be empty
batch.output.keep_tree: Files found in a folder keep their subfolder structure.
batch.output.suffix: Save as a new file next to the original
batch.output.title: Save as
batch.output.warn_backup: Originals are copied into a .sprite-tools-backup folder next to each file. You can undo right after the run.
batch.output.warn_nobackup: The original files will be changed. This cannot be undone.
batch.pack.cols_note: 0 = auto (square root of the count, rounded up)
batch.pack.note: Combines every file in the list into one sheet, ordered by the numbers in their names (frame-2, frame-10). The cell size is that of the largest image.
batch.preview.edit_title: Open this file in the editor (double-click)
batch.preview.empty: Select a file to preview the result
batch.preview.title: Preview
batch.recolor.hint: Enter a Lospec palette name to load it. A palette you have downloaded once also works offline.
batch.reduce.count_note: Automatically finds the weakest merge strength that brings the color count down to this number. Transparent color is not counted.
batch.run.confirm.one: This will overwrite {n} original file. {note} Continue?
batch.run.confirm.other: This will overwrite {n} original files. {note} Continue?
batch.run.confirm_backup: Originals will be copied to a backup folder.
batch.run.confirm_nobackup: Without a backup this cannot be undone.
batch.run.hint_all.one: Processing all {n} file regardless of the filter · Ctrl+Enter
batch.run.hint_all.other: Processing all {n} files regardless of the filter · Ctrl+Enter
batch.trim.note: Crops to the area around the non-transparent pixels, then adds this much transparent margin on every side. Images that already have that shape, or are fully transparent, are skipped.
batch.upscale.note: Enlarges pixels as they are, without interpolation (nearest neighbor).
common.size_limit: Size must be 1–{max}px, at most {mp} million pixels in total
editor.backup.title: Before overwriting an existing file, copies the original into .sprite-tools-backup in the same folder
editor.canvas.anchor_note: Anchor: choose which side of the new canvas the existing image aligns to. It is cropped when the canvas gets smaller and padded with transparency when it gets larger.
editor.canvas.anchor_title: Where to place the existing image
editor.canvas.title: Canvas size
editor.close.title: You have unsaved changes
editor.color.recent.title: Click: primary · Right-click: secondary
editor.color.swap.title: Swap primary ↔ secondary (X)
editor.empty.hint: You can also pick one from the file strip on the left, double-click one in the batch list, or drop files or folders here
editor.empty.title: Open a PNG file or create a new image
editor.fit.title: Fit to window (0)
editor.fx.cancel.title: Revert (Esc)
editor.fx.compare.title: Shows the original while held
editor.fx.despeckle_note: Connected groups of non-transparent pixels count as one piece. Any pixel with some alpha counts as content.
editor.fx.downscale_note: Restores pixel art that was saved enlarged to its original size.
editor.fx.no_pieces: There are no pieces to remove inside the selection
editor.fx.ok.title: Apply (Enter)
editor.fx.palette_file.title: Choose a palette PNG (1 color = 1px)
editor.fx.reduce_strength: Higher values merge more similar colors
editor.fx.scope_all: Applies to the whole image regardless of the selection.
editor.fx.scope_despeckle: If there is a selection, only pixels inside it are removed (otherwise the whole image).
editor.fx.scope_despeckle_sel: There is a selection, so only pixels inside it are removed. Pieces are looked for in the whole image.
editor.fx.title: Effects — {name}
editor.fx.upscale_note: Enlarges pixels as they are by an integer factor.
editor.grid.title: Pixel grid (Ctrl+' or #) — visible at 4x zoom or more
editor.hint.eraser: Both the left and right buttons erase
editor.hint.fill: Fills the clicked color area with the primary color (right: secondary color) · Alt+click: color picker
editor.hint.line: Drag · Shift: snap to 0/45/90° · Esc: cancel
editor.hint.move: Drag: move the selection (or the whole image) · Arrow keys 1px (Shift 10px) · Enter: commit · Esc: cancel
editor.hint.pencil: Left: primary color · Right: secondary color · Alt+click: color picker
editor.hint.picker: Left: to primary color · Right: to secondary color
editor.hint.select: Drag: select · Shift: add · Alt: subtract · Drag inside: move · Click empty area: deselect · Ctrl+A/D/Shift+I
editor.hint.wand: Click: select the same-color area · Shift: add · Alt: subtract · Click empty area: deselect · Delete: clear selection
editor.menu.edit.title: Copy, paste, selection
editor.menu.fx.title: Apply batch features to the current image
editor.menu.image.title: Flip, rotate, canvas size, crop
editor.new.title: New image (Ctrl+N)
editor.open.title: Open file (Ctrl+O)
editor.opt.move_note: Without a selection the whole image is moved. Parts moved off the canvas are cut off when you commit.
editor.opt.picker_note: Picks up the color (including alpha) of the clicked pixel.
editor.opt.pixel_perfect.title: Removes L-shaped corner pixels from 1px lines for cleaner strokes
editor.opt.select_note: While a selection exists, the other drawing tools only change the selected pixels.
editor.opt.wand_diag_title: When off, only pixels touching up, down, left or right count as the same area
editor.opt.wand_note: Fully transparent pixels all count as the same color. Uses the same tolerance as Fill.
editor.pal.add.title: Add the primary color to My palette
editor.pal.copy.title: Copies the palette currently shown into My palette so that you can edit it
editor.pal.copy_dialog.body: Copies the colors currently shown ({n}) into My palette. The existing contents ({m}) are replaced.
editor.pal.copy_dialog.title: Copy to My palette
editor.pal.exists_dialog.title: A palette with that name already exists
editor.pal.fetch.title: Download from Lospec, save and show
editor.pal.file.title: Open a palette PNG file (1 color = 1px)
editor.pal.image_info_many: Showing only the 256 most used of {total} colors
editor.pal.remove.title: Removes the color you clicked in the palette (or the one equal to the primary color) from My palette
editor.pal.save.title: Saves the colors shown under a name in the shared palette folder (also used by Apply palette in batch mode)
editor.pal.save_dialog.body: Saves the colors currently shown ({n}) to the shared palette folder.
editor.pal.save_dialog.note: A name may only contain lowercase letters, digits and -. Once saved, it also appears in the batch 'Apply palette' list.
editor.pal.save_dialog.title: Save as palette
editor.pal.title: Palette to show
editor.picker.system.title: System color picker
editor.picker.transparent.title: Fully transparent color
editor.redo.title: Redo (Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z)
editor.save.title: Save (Ctrl+S)
editor.save_all.title: Save all unsaved documents (Ctrl+Alt+S) — new documents without a path are skipped
editor.save_as.title: Save as (Ctrl+Shift+S)
editor.sel.floating: Floating: Enter to commit, Esc to cancel
editor.strip.add_files.title: Add PNG files to the list and open the first one (shared with the batch list)
editor.strip.add_folder.title: Add the PNGs of a folder to the list and open the first one
editor.strip.auto_save.title: Saves a modified file first when you move to the next/previous file with PageDown/PageUp (Alt+←/→) (follows the backup setting)
editor.strip.empty: The list is empty. Press a + button or drop PNG files or folders here.
editor.strip.filter.title: Same as the filter of the batch list
editor.strip.keep_zoom.title: When opening the next/previous file, keeps the zoom and position of the previous one (off: fit to window)
editor.strip.remove: Remove from list (open documents stay open)
editor.strip.title: Files
editor.sym_x.title: Horizontal symmetry — mirror left/right around the vertical center axis (pencil, eraser, line, shapes)
editor.sym_y.title: Vertical symmetry — mirror up/down around the horizontal center axis (pencil, eraser, line, shapes)
editor.tabs.clean.title: Close all unmodified (saved) tabs
editor.tabs.close.title: Close tab (Ctrl+W, middle click)
editor.tabs.preview: Preview tab — double-click it or edit it to keep it open
editor.tile.title: Tile grid spacing (px)
editor.tool.move.extra: Drag the pixels of the selection (or of the whole image) · Arrow keys: 1px, Shift+arrows: 10px
editor.tool.select.extra: Shift: add · Alt: subtract · drag inside the selection to move
editor.tool.wand.extra: Selects the area of the clicked color · Shift: add · Alt: subtract
editor.undo.title: Undo (Ctrl+Z)
editor.zoom_in.title: Zoom in (+)
editor.zoom_label.title: Zoom with Ctrl+wheel
editor.zoom_out.title: Zoom out (-)
help.batch.cancel: Cancel the job / close / clear the filter
help.batch.dblclick: Open the file in the editor (use the 'Show in folder' button to see it in the file explorer)
help.batch.hold: Show the original while held (you can also press the result pane with the mouse)
help.batch.note: Hover over a preview to see the pixel coordinates and color in its caption.
help.common.mode: Switch between Batch, Editor and Review
help.multi.close: Close the tab (a modified document asks whether to save)
help.multi.note: 'Auto-save when moving on' below the file strip saves a modified file first when you move on with PageDown/PageUp (the backup setting applies), and 'Keep zoom' opens the next file at the same zoom. The file strip and the batch list are the same list.
help.multi.pin: Keeps a preview (italic) tab. A file opened by clicking in the file strip or with PageDown is replaced by the next file in the same tab as long as you have not modified it; editing it keeps the tab
help.multi.save_all: Save all — new documents without a path are skipped
help.multi.step: Open the next · previous file of the file strip (= the batch list); works from any tool, and only shows a notice at either end
help.review.delete: Move the file to the trash folder and show the next image. With a selection or floating layer it clears the selected pixels as usual
help.review.delete_always: Always deletes the file, even with a selection
help.review.jump: First · last image · go to an image number
help.review.next: Mark the image as OK and go to the next one. A modified image is saved first. With a selection, <kbd>→</kbd> nudges the selection instead
help.review.note: Deleted files are moved to a hidden .sprite-tools-trash folder next to the image, so deleting is instant and can be undone. Move them to the Windows Recycle Bin from the bar below the canvas when you are done. Saving an edited image over the original makes a backup each time (if enabled), so thousands of edits can leave thousands of backups.
help.review.undo: Undo the last file deletion (when nothing was edited since); otherwise a normal pixel undo
help.section.review: Review mode — Going through many images
help.select.clipboard: Copy · Cut · Paste (pasted content appears as a floating selection)
help.select.commit: Commit the move · cancel the move (one commit is one undo step)
help.select.drag: Select · add to the selection · subtract from the selection (while a selection exists, every drawing tool only changes the selected pixels)
help.select.flip: Flip horizontally · vertically (the whole image if there is no selection)
help.select.note: Rotate, canvas size, crop and trim margins are in the 'Image' menu above; reduce colors, apply palette, downscale 1:1, upscale and despeckle are in the 'Effects' menu (despeckle only affects the inside of the selection, if there is one).
help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.tools.esc: Cancel the line or shape being drawn
help.tools.shift: Line: snap to 0/45/90° · Rectangle/Ellipse: square/circle (press while drawing)
help.tools.swap: Swap primary ↔ secondary color (left button = primary, right button = secondary)
help.tools.wand: Magic wand — selects the area of the clicked color (<kbd>Shift</kbd> add · <kbd>Alt</kbd> subtract). Options: include diagonals (8-way) · all same color · tolerance (shared with Fill)
help.view.grid: Toggle the pixel grid (at 4x or more)
help.view.open: Open · New (open documents stay as they are; the new one opens in a new tab)
review.empty.hint: Open a folder here, or add images in Batch mode first.
review.empty.title: Nothing to review yet
review.goto.title: Go to image
review.open_folder.title: Review the images of another folder (Ctrl+O)
review.recycle.title.one: Move the deleted file waiting in the .sprite-tools-trash folders ({mb} MB) to the Windows Recycle Bin
review.recycle.title.other: Move the {n} deleted files waiting in the .sprite-tools-trash folders ({mb} MB) to the Windows Recycle Bin
review.reset.body: Forget which images of this folder you have reviewed. Your files are not touched.
review.reset.title: Reset review progress
review.reveal.title: Show this file in the file explorer
review.toast.end_left.one: End of the list · {left} unreviewed image left
review.toast.end_left.other: End of the list · {left} unreviewed images left
review.toast.recycled.one: Moved {n} file to the Recycle Bin
review.toast.recycled.other: Moved {n} files to the Recycle Bin
review.toast.trash_pending.one: {n} deleted file is waiting in a trash folder
review.toast.trash_pending.other: {n} deleted files are waiting in trash folders
review.unreviewed_only.title: Skip images you already reviewed when stepping
status.pack_pick: Choose where to save the sheet…
toast.crop_need_selection: Select the area to crop first (M)
toast.crop_whole: The selection is the whole image
toast.fx_finish_first: Confirm (Enter) or cancel (Esc) the effect preview first
toast.list_empty: The file list is empty. Add files with + in the file strip
toast.pal_exists: That color is already in the palette
toast.pal_max: A palette holds at most 256 colors
toast.pal_name_invalid: A palette name may only contain lowercase letters, digits and - (e.g. my-palette)
toast.pal_pick_first: Click the color to remove in the palette first
toast.pal_transparent: A transparent color cannot be added to the palette
toast.paste_empty: Nothing to paste. Copy something first (Ctrl+C)
toast.saved_all_skipped.one: Skipped {n} new document without a path
toast.saved_all_skipped.other: Skipped {n} new documents without a path
toast.trim_none: There is already no transparent margin
toast.trim_transparent: The image is fully transparent, so there is nothing to trim to
